Name: Cleaner Barns and Coops
Author: fuse911
Description:
* Works for Stardew Valley v1.3.2 vanilla or with SMAPI and existing saved games.

Tired of unnecessary decoration that takes up space for other furniture like a mayonnaise maker!? Say no more.

[u][b]DISCLAIMER:[/b][/u]
[b]-[/b][i] Always back up the original and save files:[/i]
Barn.xnb / Barn2.xnb / Barn3.xnb / Coop.xnb / Coop2.xnb / Coop3.xnb located in the Maps folder.
[b]-[/b] Works with any mods and maps as long as it doesn't change/replace the Barn.xnb and Coop.xnb files.

[u][b]INSTALLATION:[/b][/u]
1. Download the file and open with winrar/zip.
2. Locate your "Maps" Folder in the installed directory. [i]For Example on[/i] [b]Steam[/b] C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps
3. Drag and Drop all or selected files from the winrar/zip folder to the Maps folder and replace the existing files.

Done, now try it out.

[u]UNINSTALL:[/u]
Assuming you made a backup copy of your original Maps files...
1. Copy and paste your original Barn.xnb and Coop.xnb files back into the Maps folder and replace the existing modded files.

[b][u]CREDITS:
[/u][/b]Thanks to the developer and publisher for this wonderful game.
Feel free to edit this mod to suit your style.
